title: Life Skills in Ecs: Main Exam, 8 August 2018
programme: Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

parts.text: Outline four life skills in the first category (life skills of understanding and living with self).
Identify three educational benefits of life skills.
Mention six steps in esteem building.
Describe the three types of behaviour.
Discuss three categories of non-verbal communication.
i) Define critical thinking. ii) Identify the seven core critical thinking skills.
Describe any five positive attitudes for creativity.
Identify the origins of low self-esteem.
Discuss the role of a pre-primary day school in inculcating behaviour in children.

items.text: Discuss the strategies of managing emotions a guest counsellor is likely to recommend to the managers of pre-primary/day care centres at a Bidii sub-county workshop organized by the newly elected member of parliament.
